sustainabilityPage.introText: At Endo Tech Group of Industries, we believe that advancing healthcare must not come at the expense of our planet. Our green manufacturing initiatives in Sialkot integrate renewable energy, zero chemical discharge, and circular metallurgical recycling.

initiatives.title: 100% Recyclable Medical-Grade Steel
initiatives.desc: All AISI 420 and German stainless steel offcuts and swarf are 100% segregated and recycled into secondary industrial processes, achieving near-zero metallurgical scrap.

initiatives.title: Solar Powered Clean Facility
initiatives.desc: Our manufacturing campus operates a 250 kW on-site rooftop solar photovoltaic system, reducing carbon emissions by 180 metric tons annually.

initiatives.title: Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) Effluent Plant
initiatives.desc: All electropolishing, ultrasonic washing, and passivating wastewater undergoes multi-stage chemical and biological treatment, recycling clean water back into processing.

initiatives.title: Eco-Friendly Biodegradable Packaging
initiatives.desc: Non-sterile bulk packaging uses 100% recycled unbleached cardboard and water-soluble protective coatings, eliminating single-use plastics.
